sources.name: Axial / Horizon — original AXI00007 model manual and installed-equipment identification
Spektrum — SPMXSE2425RX operating states, alarms and troubleshooting

Traxxas — glossary; BEC, receiver, ESC and failsafe terminology

scope: A beginner’s observation and decision guide for an electric hobby RC car that previously drove, or a completed RTR whose steering responds to new transmitter commands. It covers power-off visual inspection and matching symptoms to exact manufacturer instructions. It does not provide charging settings, controller programming, direct-battery motor tests, electrical measurements or repair procedures. Modified cars require the installed equipment’s documentation, not just the original vehicle manual. No hands-on fault finding or repair success rate is claimed.
media: Original accessible four-stage HTML/CSS observation route; no new photographs or physical demonstration.
notes: Only exact XL-5 HV and SPMXSE2425RX indicator examples are given. No general voltage threshold, button sequence, charging setting or protection bypass.
No Amazon API, credentials, authentication, offer refresh or workflow used. No direct buying links needed.
Separate guide quota; no additional vehicle reviews or listicle. Owner policy edits remain separate.

Axial model manual p3 identifies SPMXSE2425RX; p10 parts list omits the E in its abbreviation. Exact controller manual uses SPMXSE2425RX. Indicators checked against that document, not the abbreviated parts row.
